manufacturing: 4-axis turn-mill uses two setups, including reversal and re-clamping.
Finished stator housings receive sample dimensional inspection after machining.
Color anodizing is outsourced; color is controlled by approved sample; approximately 5 µm applies only to stator color anodizing.
51.7 µm is one photo reading at one point on one rotor, not a batch value.
Hard anodizing increasing surface hardness is approved by the owner.
Coating-thickness uniformity within each production batch is confirmed by the owner.
No certification, salt-spray duration, lifetime or zero-wear claim was introduced.
production: Every finished unit and each individual passage are checked.
Compressed air at 1.0 MPa; about 1 second pressurization and 4 seconds hold.
Other passages remain unpressurized and open to atmosphere.
Equipment returns only PASS/NG and does not locate or diagnose leakage.
NG items enter a yellow quarantine container; repairable items receive full passage retest; non-repairable items are scrapped.
No alarm threshold, zero-leak, calibration certification, batch certificate, first-pass yield or customer acceptance claim was introduced.
bp2p95: Model identity comes from project-owner confirmation.
All workshop photos are customer-authorized for public web use.
Photos document only visible pneumatic-chuck assembly, compressed-air routing and installation relationships; they do not independently establish model identity.
No commissioning, trial run, delivery, customer acceptance, long-term operation, pressure, speed, temperature, lifetime or leakage result was introduced.
bp3ps06: In this customer design the three pneumatic passages correspond to clamp, unclamp and dust-blow functions.
The slip ring only carries external sensor signals; external sensors and the machine controller perform detection and logic.
Customer passage allocation is not a universal port map.
No self-detection, interlock, fail-safe, accuracy or response-time claim was introduced.
Batch-preparation photos are not described as test PASS or final inspection evidence.
